links.outcome: Accuracy on previously incorrect items with and without retrieved abstracts in the prompt
links.effect: Gold-source abstract raised accuracy on previously incorrect items to 0.79; top 3 PubMed abstracts improved it to 0.23; random abstracts reduced it to 0.10 (within temperature variation).
links.quote: When we incorporate retrieval-augmented prompting, providing the gold-source abstract raises accuracy on previously incorrect items to 0.79; providing top 3 PubMed abstracts (ranked by semantic relevance) improves accuracy to 0.23, while random abstracts reduce accuracy (0.10, within temperature variation).

unlisted_practices: Stratified evaluation of LLM accuracy by specialty, question type and source

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLMs on clinical evidence-based QA benchmarks comparing baseline performance with and without retrieval-augmented prompting (RAG).
